name: WCC CF7 to Notion
author: weconnectcodeplugins

sections.description:
Contact Form 7 Notion Plugin sends form submissions from Contact Form 7 plugins to Notion when someone submits a form. Learn more about Contact Form 7 Notion Plugin at weconnectcode.com. We also offer other connector for Clio Contact Form 7 Clio Integration.

License

GPLv2 or later

How to Setup

  • Go to “Notion Accounts” tab then add new account.
  • Go to “Notion Integration” tab then create new Integration.
  • Map required Notion fields to contact form 7 fields.
  • Send your test entry to Notion by submiting contact form 7.
  • Go to “Notion Logs” tab and verify, if entry was sent to Notion.

Connect Notion account

Connect any contact form 7 to Notion account by safe and secure Oauth 2.0.

Map Notion fields

First select any Notion object then Map contact form fields to Notion object fields. There is No limitation on number of fields. You can map unlimited fields.

Filter contact form 7 submissions

Either Send all contact form 7 submissions to Notion or filter contact form submissions sent to Notion based on user input. For example , send only those entries to Notion which have work email address.

Manually send to Notion

Send contact form 7 submissions to Notion when someone submits a contact form. You can manually send contact form submissions to Notion.

Notion logs

View a detailed log of each contact form 7 submission whether sent (or not sent) to Notion and easily resend any contact form submission to Notion.

Send Data As Notion object Notes

Send one to many contact form fields as Notion object notes when anyone submits a form on your site.

Why we built this plugin

Contact Form 7 and some other popular contact forms are good but you can not send contact form submissions to any crm including Notion. You can send any contact form submissions from your wordpress site to Notion with this free wordpress Notion plugin.

Premium Version Features.

This plugin has a Premium version which comes with several additional benifits Contact Form 7 – Notion.

  • Notion Custom fields and Particularly Phone Fields.
  • Notion Notes Field
  • User Agent and IP related Data Of the Entries
  • WCC Entries Pro Version With all the Premium Features.
  • Super Helpful WCC Addons and Free Updates.
  • By Purchasing the Premium Version of the Plugin, You will Get Free Updates
  • Get Pro Support

sections.faq:
Where can I get support?

Our team provides free support at https://weconnectcode.com/contact.

How to integrate Notion in contact form 7

You can easily integrate Notion in contact form 7. Simply install Contact Form 7 Notion plugin , Connect Notion account and finally map contact form fields to Notion object(contact,lead,account etc) fields.

Contact form 7 Notion web to lead

if API access is not enabled for your organization then simply use Notion web to lead. Enter your organization id and map contact form fields to Notion case or lead fields.

WordPress Notion Integration

  • You can use Contact Form 7 or any other wordpress forms plugin.
  • Install this free WordPress Notion Integration plugin then Connect your Notion account to wordpress.
  • Create a Notion Integration , select form then map form fields to Notion Object(Lead, account etc) fields.
  • When anyone submits form , it will go to your Notion account.

Notion WordPress Plugin

  • Easily Connect your Notion account to wordpress site with this free wordpress Notion plugin.
  • First Install Contact Form 7 plugin and create a simple form.
  • Connect Notion account to wordpress.
  • Create a Notion Integration then map contact form fields to Notion object(lead, contact etc) fields.
  • All form submissions will automatically go to your Notion account.

External services

This plugin integrates with the Notion platform. When a user submits a form using Contact Form 7, their data is sent to Notion via their API.

Details:
Service Name: Notion
Purpose: To capture and manage inquiries submitted via Contact Form 7 in the Notion CRM for efficient client management and follow-ups.
Data Sent: Form submission data, including (but not limited to) user-provided name, email, phone number, and message content.
Endpoint: Data is sent securely to the Notion API endpoint.

API Endpoints Used:
    Authorization Endpoint: https://app.notion.com/oauth/authorize
    Token Endpoint: https://api.notion.com/oauth/token
    API Base URL: https://api.notion.com/v1/

Privacy and Terms:
    <a href="https://www.notion.com/terms-of-use/">Notion Terms of Service</
    <a href="https://www.notion.com/privacy-policy/">Notion Privacy Policy</
